europe_now.title: Spanish Transport Minister Resigns After Deadly Train Crash
europe_now.summary: Spain's transport minister has stepped down from his position following a fatal railway accident that drew national scrutiny. The resignation occurred days after the tragedy prompted widespread public concern over transportation safety.

europe_now.title: Bomb Threats Disrupt Multiple Flights Across Europe
europe_now.summary: A series of bomb threats targeted multiple airline flights throughout Europe, causing significant disruption across the aviation network. Authorities responded by implementing emergency protocols, including the temporary closure of Warsaw's airport.

sources.headline: Bomb threats against European airlines force Warsaw airport closure, affect several flights

top_stories.summary: Casualties mounted in Ukraine following a series of military attacks directed by Russian forces against urban infrastructure. Ongoing combat operations continue to strain regional stability and increase the humanitarian toll.

top_stories.title: Political and Institutional Disputes in Poland
top_stories.summary: Political tensions in Poland intensified as the disputed constitutional court convened following a government-backed judicial takeover. Prime Minister Donald Tusk and opposition figures remain locked in a sharp power struggle over control of the nation's top legal institutions.
